You are supervising a team and ensure that our guests are having a memorable stay together with the operational departments.Your day will consist of...• Supervising the Housekeeping team• Making a planning for the day• Assisting the team in cleaning (rooms and public area) whenever necessary• Taking responsibility for cleanliness and restocking of cabinets and trolleys• Ensuring brand standards and cleaning procedures up to date and are being followed• Assisting the Housekeeping Manager in administration tasks• Communicate with operational departmentsFunctie-eisen:You…• Have a passion for cleaning and have previous experience in a similar role• Are a team player• Are punctual and detail orientated• Are flexible and can easily adapt• Have a positive mindset and can perform well under pressure• Are flexible to work on weekdays, weekends and public holidays• Have a good understanding of the English languageWe…• Offer you a great place to work in a diverse team!• Offer a dynamic working environment and team with a work hard, play hard kind of mentality• Offer a working environment where learning & development are a priority (internal and external job trainings will be provided regularly)• Have a special Associate Discount Rate in all Marriott Hotels worldwide• Competitive salary according to the Horeca Collective Labor AgreementAnd also a lot of very nice Employee Benefits from IHCP Hotels like…• A bucket list program where we safe money for your wish list• Enjoy a free guest experience in the hotel you work for• Not sick bonus up to €250 • Free night stay• Recruitment incentive up to €250• Special rates in all our hotels• Discounts with your IHCP employee cardAccess to unlimited digita
